Name: Iddo
Summary: Iddo is named as the grandfather of the prophet Zechariah (Zechariah 1:1), and is also called 'Iddo the prophet' among those who encouraged the Temple rebuilding. He stands at the head of Zechariah's line, a prophet himself in the generation of the return.
KeyStory: Iddo, grandfather of Zechariah and himself called a prophet, is named among those whose words spurred the returned exiles to rebuild the Temple.
LifeLesson: Iddo's line runs prophet to prophet, grandfather to grandson. Faith handed down is still the surest inheritance.
